name: Hearts Faster Than Light
source:
With nothing good keeping them on their home planet, Dawn embarks on a cross galactic flight to start a new life.  Dawn is attending their best friends wedding, when suddenly one of the Galaxy's most dangerous criminals attacks. From here on out, They are wrapped up in the chase to find and stop the mind shattering criminal known only as the Scrambler. How will Dawn cope with the pressure of their new life in space?

[From [url=https://arcadiaadair.itch.io/hearts-faster-than-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于没有什么好办法让他们留在自己的星球上，黎明踏上了穿越银河的飞行，开始了新的生活。黎明正在参加他们最好的朋友的婚礼，这时银河系最危险的罪犯之一突然袭击了他。从现在开始，他们全神贯注于寻找并阻止这个被称为“扰乱者”的令人心碎的罪犯。黎明将如何应对太空新生活的压力？

[来自[url=https://arcadiaadair.itch.io/hearts-faster-than-light]Itch.io[/url]]
